//: Guardrails record — docs/guardrails.md says what each capability means here. Every capability appears once: either the tool implementing it, or off with why and who. Changes require human review via CODEOWNERS.

typecheck.why: plain ESM JavaScript — no TypeScript or jsconfig checkJs in use, so there is no type system to check

tests.tool: node --test (node:test); E2E journey via the public exports entry (test/journey.test.mjs)

secrets.tool: secretlint (preset-recommend + pattern rule) at commit; GitHub secret scanning + push protection (see BOOTSTRAP-REPORT.md)

ci-verify.tool: GitHub Actions: .github/workflows/guardrails.yml runs npm run verify on every PR

branch-review.tool: GitHub branch protection — PR-only, required verify check, enforce_admins (exact commands in BOOTSTRAP-REPORT.md)

supply-chain.tool: npm min-release-age=7 + audit-level=high (.npmrc); Dependabot alerts+updates and CodeQL via GitHub (exact commands in BOOTSTRAP-REPORT.md)
